evidence: t=5.0 to t=7.0 gloved hand on left side with phillips screwdriver tip engaged on the left screw above the battery unscrewing; t=7.25 hand lifts tool off screw and moves away; t=7.5-9.75 no hands visible; t=10.0-10.25 hand re-enters moving toward right side; t=10.5 onward hand with tool engaged on the right-side screw above the battery unscrewing

t16.00-t17.50 right gloved hand holds screwdriver down on top-right above battery working the right-side screw; t17.75 hand lifts up away from screw; t18.00-t20.00 no hands visible; t20.25 left gloved hand enters with screwdriver hovering over left battery; t20.50 onward tip engaged on bottom-left battery screw unscrewing.

Left gloved hand holds red-handled phillips screwdriver with tip on the bottom-left battery/chassis screw from ~20.5s through 28.0s unscrewing, right hand steadies top-right chassis from 23.25s; at 28.25s screwdriver is lifted away over left fan with no contact. narrow.evidence: Left gloved hand holds Phillips screwdriver with tip engaged on the bottom-left battery screw from t=20.50 through t=24.75, maintaining position at the bottom-left edge while unscrewing; right hand only steadies chassis from t=23.00 onward. t=20.00 shows no hands and t=20.25 shows approach above battery with no engagement. evidence: At 27.75-28.0 left gloved hand holds phillips screwdriver tip engaged on the bottom screw at the lower edge of the battery/chassis while right hand stabilizes top. At 28.25 screwdriver is lifted away and blurred. No hands 28.5-29.5. At 30.0 hands re-enter with tool over motherboard, then at 30.25 onward right/left gloved hand is over the bottom edge of motherboard/battery top covering the battery cable connector area working to pry it.

Around 36.5 the right gloved hand still covers the battery-motherboard junction where the battery cable connector is, obscuring the pry work; at 36.75 the hand is lifted clear holding the white pry tool over the right-side silver plate away from the connector in transit. Around 39.25 both hands hold the top chassis corners; at 39.5 the left hand moves down onto the top edge of the black laptop battery to grip it, starting the lift.
